title: HTTP gateway status distinctions
summary: Distinguish 502, 503 and 504 evidence before investigating the wrong layer.

concepts.title: 502 Bad Gateway
concepts.explanation: A gateway or proxy received an invalid response from an upstream server.

concepts.title: 503 Service Unavailable
concepts.explanation: The server is currently unable to handle the request, often temporarily.

concepts.title: 504 Gateway Timeout
concepts.explanation: A gateway or proxy did not receive a timely upstream response.

limitations: The status alone does not identify which intermediary generated it.
Different products can map internal failures to these statuses differently.
